desc: Write code to read input N, A, and B.
Identify indices where both A[i] and B[i] are not -1.
If such indices exist, verify all their sums are equal. If not, print No.
If such indices exist, let S be that sum. Check if S >= 0.
For all indices i, check consistency with S:
If A[i] != -1 and B[i] != -1, ensure A[i]+B[i] == S.
If A[i] == -1 and B[i] != -1, ensure S >= B[i].
If A[i] != -1 and B[i] == -1, ensure S >= A[i].
If both are -1, no constraint on S other than S >= 0.
If all checks pass, print Yes.
If no fixed pairs exist, print Yes (since we can always choose a sufficiently large S).
